_comment: Standard `mcpServers` format — the same file Claude Desktop and .mcp.json use,
so an existing config works here unchanged. Point HARNESS_MCP_CONFIG at a copy.
Secrets use ${VAR} and are read from the environment at load time, so this file
is safe to commit. The token never enters the file and never reaches the model:
the harness holds it and attaches it when calling the server, so a prompt
injection cannot exfiltrate what the model never had.
A server whose ${VAR} is unset is reported as failed on its own; the others
still load, and GET /v1/tools names the missing variable.
Every MCP tool counts as dangerous, so no principal gets one by default. Grant
them in the principals file, by exact name or with a glob covering a server:
Tools are named <prefix>_<tool>, so `prefix` below decides the glob.

_note: A personal access token is enough — there is no separate MCP token.
A classic ghp_ token is preferable: the server reads its scopes and hides
tools it cannot use. The remote endpoint needs a Copilot plan (any, incl.
Free), and PATs are disabled by default for Enterprise Managed Users.
Check yours with scripts/check-github-mcp.sh, and if the remote endpoint
refuses you, use the github-local entry below instead.
tool_filters keeps this read-only; drop it to allow writes.

github-local._note: GitHub's server run locally: no Copilot plan, no remote endpoint. Enable this OR the one above — both use the 'github' prefix, and two servers sharing a prefix collide.

gdrive._note: stdio server. Needs a one-time OAuth flow; see its own README.

filesystem._note: disabled:true keeps a server configured but switched off.

internal._note: Servers are loaded independently, so a missing token here disables only this one. Avoid continue_on_error:true — it hides the reason a server did not start.
